svg.aria-label: LibreChat v0.8.9 agent front-door press (released Nov 17, 2026). A chat message enters from the inbox stack on the left and rides the belt under the agent selector drum, whose six ports are the six services — the pointer rests on the selected one. Then it passes under the approval-gate press; the die stamps the verdict, but nothing writes until the lit-orange APPROVE lever is pulled, and only then does the card leave as an action into the tray on the right. Unapproved cards stay held in the drawer pulled out below the press, and the dial reads 0 writes. Verified numbers: v0.8.9 Nov 17, 2026; about 47,400 GitHub stars; MIT licence; 6 services; 3 API parts; 0 writes without approval.
svg.text: 6 SERVICES · 3 API PARTS · 0 WRITES WITHOUT APPROVAL
